message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend** periods that arise from Canada’s statutory holidays in **2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and the adjacent weekend days.)

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday(s) | Day of Week of Holiday | Notes |
|--------------------|------------|------------------------|-------|
| **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Feb 20) | Monday | Observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday (Apr 7) | Friday | All provinces. (Easter Sunday is the following weekend.) |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day (May 22) | Monday | All provinces. |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day (Sep 4) | Monday | All provinces. |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving (Oct 9) | Monday | All provinces. |
| **Dec 23 – 26** | Christmas (Dec 25) + Boxing Day (Dec 26) | Monday + Tuesday | All provinces. (Dec 23‑26 gives a 4‑day stretch, but the core long weekend is Dec 23‑26.) |

### Holidays that fall on a weekend (no extra long weekend)

| Holiday | Date | Day of Week | Notes |
|---------|------|-------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Already a weekend. |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Already a weekend. |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | Already a weekend. |

> **Pro‑Tip:** Some provinces have additional statutory holidays (e.g., Family Day on a different date, St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, etc.). If your app needs province‑specific data, you’ll want to pull the holiday calendar for each province separately.

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for generating calendar events. If you need the data in a machine‑readable format (JSON, CSV, etc.), let me know!
